summary: A new investment experience in the Nubank app analyzes a customer's portfolio and gives impartial suggestions on diversification, return, liquidity, protection and efficiency. It is rolling out gradually in Brazil.

title: Simplii launches Simplii Account and pilots Folders and payment backup
summary: Simplii announced a new account type, a pilot of in-app account folders, a payment backup feature that covers certain transactions to avoid insufficient funds fees, and a partnership with CIBC Investor's Edge so clients can invest while accessing funds from their Simplii account.

title: Simplii head says no chasing 'flavours of the day' like prediction markets
summary: In interviews around the Simplii Account launch, Atanaska Novakova said Simplii is targeting DIY clients who want control and value. She said it is deliberately avoiding speculative features such as prediction markets. Simplii has more than 2 million clients.

title: Simplii launches new 'Simplii Account' and pilots account folders and payment backup
summary: Simplii announced a new account type and is piloting in-app folders that clients can self-build, plus a payment backup feature that automatically covers certain transactions to reduce insufficient-funds fees. Aimed at DIY banking clients; Simplii has 2M+ clients.

title: Simplii partners with CIBC Investor's Edge so clients can invest from their Simplii account
summary: New partnership lets Simplii clients invest through CIBC Investor's Edge while accessing funds from their Simplii account, announced alongside the new Simplii Account.
source: The Globe and Mail / The Canadian Press

title: Simplii Financial launches the Simplii Account and pilots account folders
summary: Simplii is adding a new account type for DIY clients. It is piloting folders in the mobile app and a payment-backup feature meant to cut insufficient-funds fees. Shareable folders for household expenses are planned in the coming months.

title: Simplii Financial: $350 welcome bonus with no monthly account fees
summary: Listed as a top Canadian bank promotion for November 2026. Simplii's offer combines a $350 welcome bonus with no monthly account fees. Aggregator source, so verify terms on simplii.com.

title: Neo Financial Mastercard: $25 cash bonus and up to 15% cash back at partners
summary: New Neo cardholders get a $25 cash bonus, with up to 15% cash back at Neo partner stores and retail locations. Aggregator source, so verify terms on neofinancial.com.

title: EQ Bank savings promo: up to 2.75% interest
summary: EQ Bank is listed among the top Canadian bank offers with interest of up to 2.75%. Aggregator source, so verify terms on eqbank.ca.

title: SoFi direct deposit bonus promotion runs May 15 – Dec 31, 2026
summary: SoFi's two-tier direct deposit promotion is open to eligible new and existing members who have not previously set up direct deposit on SoFi Checking and Savings. Secondary source, so verify terms on sofi.com.

title: RBC upgrades Cash Back Mastercard portfolio: uncapped 3% categories and $1 redemptions
summary: New earn structures took effect Oct 1, 2026. The Cash Back Preferred World Elite Mastercard earns uncapped 3% on everyday categories such as groceries, dining, gas and streaming. From December 2026, cardholders can redeem cash back anytime from $1. The date is the effective date, not a confirmed publish date.

title: Chime to buy Stride Bank for $590M and rebrand it Chime Bank, N.A.
summary: The all-cash deal brings a bank charter in-house, removing partner-bank fees and giving Chime control over compliance and settlement. Management raised guidance at the same time. The date is that of the Fintech Brainfood coverage, not a confirmed announcement date.

title: Chime: Loop Capital initiates coverage after the Stride Bank deal
summary: Shares rose about 7% after the $590M Stride Bank announcement. Loop Capital started coverage with a Buy rating and a $45 price target, citing in-house infrastructure.

title: Nubank launches in the U.S. via Lead Bank and introduces Nu Global
summary: Nubank began U.S. operations through a sponsor-bank partnership with Lead Bank while it awaits final OCC charter approval. It also launched Nu Global, a multi-currency account covering 35+ countries.

title: Nubank U.S. offer: 3.50% yield savings, 1.5% cash back no-fee card, free international transfers
summary: Per Reuters, initial U.S. products through FDIC-insured Lead Bank are deposit accounts at a 3.50% yield, free international money transfers, and a no-fee credit card with 1.5% cash back.

title: Nubank launches U.S. banking operations through partner Lead Bank
summary: Nubank went live in the U.S. at an event in Miami while it awaits final OCC approval of its national bank charter. It offers a deposit account, a no-annual-fee credit card and no-fee transfers to Brazil and Mexico.

title: Nubank introduces Nu Global, a multi-currency digital asset account across 35+ countries
summary: Introduced at the U.S. launch event. A multi-currency, stablecoin-linked account for international customers and no-fee money movement across more than 35 countries.

title: Nubank U.S. launch offer: 3.5% APY account and 1.5% cashback no-fee card
summary: The Nu Account pays 3.5% APY at launch. The credit card has no annual fee and offers unlimited 1.5% cash back, with a route to 2%.

title: Nubank launches US banking operations through Lead Bank while awaiting its OCC charter
summary: The Brazilian digital bank went live in the US through a partner-bank model. It has conditional OCC approval from January and is still seeking full approval. The launch includes a 3.5% APY deposit account and a no-fee card with 1.5% cashback.

title: Nubank US offer: 3.5% APY, rising to 4.5% with its credit card; 1.5% unlimited cashback
summary: The Nu Account pays 3.5% APY. Cardholders who use the card three times a month can earn up to 4.5% on balances up to $10k. The card has no annual fee and 1.5% cashback, with a route to 2%.

title: Nubank introduces Nu Global, a multi-currency digital asset account covering 35+ countries
summary: Launched at the Miami US event, the account supports no-fee money movement across more than 35 countries. It is stablecoin-linked and comes with a card.
